entity_raw.definition_raw:
You know that daring deeds and heroics live forever in song, and sagas will carry your deeds into immortality.

Prerequisite(s): Human.

Benefit(s): Whenever you start or end a charge attack in a space adjacent to an ally who also has this feat, you gain a +2 morale bonus on one attack roll you make as part of the charge. Furthermore, you can charge through a space containing an ally who also has this feat.
